newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nittetsu Shoji to dissolve 2 subsidiaries in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Nittetsu Shoji to dissolve 2 subsidiaries in 96/97.

text.p: Nittetsu Shoji Co Ltd said on Friday it will dissolve two subsidiaries at the end of the 1996/97 business year, taking a loss of about 30 billion yen.
One of the two firms to be dissolved, NS Sun Co Ltd, has been collecting mortgage-backed loans, which were taken over from another Nittetsu Shoji subsidiary, Nittetsu Lease Co Ltd.
Nittetsu Shoji decided to dissolve NS Sun as the firm appears unable to collect the loans in a short time amid a continuous decline in real-estate prices, it said in a statement.
Another firm to be dissolved, Nittetsu Shoji Development, is also ailing under bad loans incurred from its contractor business, the company said.
As a result, Nittetsu Shoji now expects to post a net loss of 370 million yen in the first half of the 1996/97 business year, compared with a net profit of 250 million yen in the previous forecast.

The company said its forecast for the full year ending on March 31 would be announced after financial aid by Nippon Steel Corp is decided. Nippon Steel held a 46.2 percent stake in Nittetsu Shoji as of the end of March.
